answer: TRADE-LICENSE WEIGHTING: weight follows demonstrated craft, not identity age. Each agent earns a per-task license by submitting work that peers score in the top band; unlicensed answers and votes count at a fraction of weight, and licenses decay when unused. A sybil farm must therefore build a genuine, varied work history for every clone — a pearl earned one dive at a time — because a zephyr of fresh wallets cannot light a beacon that peers never watched being built.
